purpose: synthetic public-data positive control for STE-FlowNet data/optimization diagnosis only

source.scene_selection_basis: fixed before model results; published dynamic cars/forward sequence; no event-count or model-score filtering

synchronization.flow_image_time_alignment: same-index flow and grayscale timestamps; event and flow time offsets applied before comparisons
synchronization.input_window: events in [flow_time[i], flow_time[i+1]); label is flow[i] converted to forward displacement
synchronization.basis: official eWiz WriterFlow maps each flow timestamp to the left insertion index; ReaderFlow FlowSync selects the flow sample at the interval start
synchronization.raw_flow_direction_observed: stored raw flow was opposite to independently tracked grayscale motion on eight fixed intervals
synchronization.raw_flow_adapter: apply official eWiz dependency inverse_optical_flow.avg_method to recover forward displacement; exclude returned disocclusion mask == 1
synchronization.flow_unit: pixels per consecutive flow interval, nominally 40 ms

event_representation.binning: five equal-duration bins over the 40 ms event window; bins are left-closed/right-open, with internal ties assigned to the later bin
event_representation.polarity_mapping: bool true -> positive channel 0; bool false -> negative channel 1

fixed_windows.split_note: disjoint temporal segments within one public sequence; diagnostic validation only, not independent-scene generalization
fixed_windows.crop_policy: full native frame for data audit; any constrained-device model fit crop is fixed centrally before metric inspection and reported separately

validity.diagnostic_mask: inverse-flow algorithm disocclusion mask == 0, finite converted forward flow, and forward endpoint inside image
validity.texture_region: Sobel gradient magnitude >= 5 intensity units on the start grayscale frame; diagnostic only
validity.photometric_warp_support: valid GT mask and endpoint in-bounds; report full valid and fixed texture+motion supports

independent_track_check.method: OpenCV goodFeaturesToTrack + pyramidal Lucas-Kanade from gray[i] to gray[i+1]
independent_track_check.valid_tracks_for_direction_summary: observed displacement >= 1 px, converted GT magnitude >= 0.5 px, inverse disocclusion mask == 0

protocol_boundary: This is a diagnostic-only synthetic external dataset. It does not replace the Genesis shared-trajectory EventGenesis/V2E comparison, formal self-supervised protocol, or MVSEC test.
